name: Cedarbrook
description: A quiet fictional American suburb south of Atlanta. Tree-lined streets, a close-knit community, one church that anchors the social life, and a growing local economy.

maroni_house.label: Maroni Residence
maroni_house.description: A tidy two-bedroom home with a small front porch. Immaculately kept inside by Lily. Warm, simple, lived-in.

callahan_house.label: Callahan Residence
callahan_house.description: A larger home on the same street. Always has someone coming or going. Feels like a second church annex most days.

cornerstone_church.label: Cornerstone Community Church
cornerstone_church.description: A mid-sized non-denominational church. Warm wood interiors, stained glass, a small food pantry in the back.

maroni_fashion_hq.label: Maroni Fashion Group HQ
maroni_fashion_hq.description: A modern open-plan office space. Erin was the first tenant in the building. Design boards everywhere, fabric swatches on every surface.
